metadata.title: Software and Experimental Data for: GCond - Gradient Conflict Resolution via Accumulation-based Stabilization for Large-Scale Multi-Task Learning
metadata.description:
This repository contains the official source code and experimental data (TensorBoard logs) for the research paper "GCond: Gradient Conflict Resolution via Accumulation-based Stabilization for Large-Scale Multi-Task Learning."

The study addresses the significant challenge of gradient conflicts in multi-task learning (MTL), where existing resolution methods like PCGrad and CAGrad are often too computationally demanding for modern large-scale models. We introduce Gradient Conductor (GCond), a novel method that enhances the principles of PCGrad by integrating them with gradient accumulation and an adaptive arbitration mechanism. This "accumulate-then-resolve" strategy utilizes low-variance gradients to make more stable and precise corrections to the optimization trajectory.

The effectiveness of GCond was validated on self-supervised image reconstruction tasks using MobileNetV3-Small and ConvNeXt architectures. Experiments were conducted on the ImageNet 1K dataset and a large-scale combined dataset of head and neck CT scans.

Our results show that GCond's stochastic mode achieves a two-fold computational speedup while maintaining optimization quality. It consistently outperformed baseline linear combinations and other state-of-the-art methods across all evaluated metrics, demonstrating superior scalability and compatibility with modern optimizers like AdamW and Lion/LARS.

The uploaded archive includes:
- The complete PyTorch source code for the GCond module and experimental setups.
- Scripts used for model training and evaluation.
- TensorBoard logs from all experiments, which provide the raw data used to generate the figures and tables in the paper.
